name: TPS5430
description: Proven 36 V, 3 A non-synchronous 500 kHz buck with internal compensation in a PowerPAD SOIC-8, for 24 V robot rails.
notes: Needs an external Schottky diode (e.g. B340A).
Fixed 500 kHz voltage-mode PWM with no light-load mode: ~2 mA quiescent.
Pins 2 and 3 are NC; the PowerPAD must be soldered to GND.

en.note: ENA has an internal 1.5 MΩ pull-up; leave floating to run. Above 1.3 V (max) starts, below 0.5 V stops. Abs max 7 V, so never tie to VIN. Control only with open-drain/open-collector logic; do NOT connect a resistor from ENA to GND.

coutEq.note: Voltage mode, internal type III: keep crossover 3–30 kHz. COUT = 1 / (3357·L·fCO·VOUT) (eq. 8); ESRmax = 1 / (2π·COUT·fCO) (eq. 9).

notes: Voltage-mode control with input feed-forward (gain 25) and internal type III compensation (fp0 2165 Hz, fz1 2170 Hz, fz2 2590 Hz, fp1 24 kHz, fp2 54 kHz). Fixed 500 kHz (400-600 kHz), not adjustable. Non-synchronous: needs external Schottky catch diode PH-to-GND.

Default design µses an electrolytic / polymer output cap with defined ESR: Fig 7-1 µses one 220 µF Sanyo POSCAP 10TPB220M (10 V, 40 mOhm max ESR). Keep crossover 3-30 kHz: fCO = fLC^2 / (85 x VOUT) (eq. 7); COUT = 1 / (3357 x LOUT x fCO x VOUT) (eq. 8, 220 µF for 15 µH at 18 kHz, 5 V); ESRmax = 1 / (2*pi*COUT*fCO) (eq. 9); ESR zero must be above crossover but not far above the 24 kHz / 54 kHz internal poles at minimum ESR.
LMIN = VOUT*(VINmax - VOUT)/(VINmax*KIND*IOUT*fSW) (eq. 4); KIND 0.2-0.3; L typically 10-100 µH.

All-ceramic output is possible only with an extra external network (Fig 7-11, 3.3 V, 15 µH, 100 µF): LC resonance <= 7 kHz, CO(min) = 1/((2*pi*7000)^2 x LO) (eq. 16); FLC = 1/(2*pi*sqrt(LO*CO_eff)); Fp1 = 500000 x VO / FLC, Fz1 = 0.7 x FLC, Fz2 = 2.5 x FLC (2.3-2.7 ok); C7 = 1/(2*pi*Fp1*(R1||R2)) in series with R3 = 1/(2*pi*Fz1*C7) from VSENSE to GND; C6 = 1/(2*pi*Fz2*R1) across R1; C4 (< C6/10, 150 pF) VSENSE to GND. Example values: C7 0.1 µF, R3 549 ohm, C6 1500 pF, C4 150 pF, R1 10k, R2 5.9k.
Feedback: start with top R1 = 10k for any design; R2 = R1 x 1.221 / (VOUT - 1.221) (eq. 12). Minimum VOUT = 1.221 V.

VOUT limits: VOUTmax = 0.87 x ((VINmin - IOmax x 0.230) + VD) - IOmax x RL - VD (eq. 13, µses 87% min duty); VOUTmin = 0.12 x ((VINmax - IOmin x 0.110) + VD) - IOmin x RL - VD (eq. 14, tON(min) up to 200 ns). DMAX 87% min / 89% typ.
Boot cap must be 0.01 µF low-ESR X5R/X7R, rated >= 10 V (BOOT-PH can reach 6-10 V in operation).

Input: 10 µF X5R/X7R ceramic recommended (min 4.7 µF per layout section) placed within 1 mm of VIN and GND pins; add ~100 µF electrolytic bulk if the supply is more than a few inches away. Rec. VIN 5.5-36 V (UVLO 5.3 V typ).
Other datasheet examples: 10-35 V in, 5 V out: 22 µH, 220 µF POSCAP, Cin 2 x 4.7 µF, R1 10k / R2 3.24k (Fig 7-9). TPS5431 is the 23 V variant.
Catalog voutMax 31 V is not stated in the datasheet; it is roughly eq. 13 at 36 V in / 3 A (about 30.6 V with VD 0.5 V, RL 0).
Pins 2 and 3 are NC. Solder the exposed pad to GND.
